# Generated Code

This directory contains **auto-generated** TypeScript code from `entities.yaml`.

## ⚠️ DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY

All files in this directory are generated by the backend codegen tool.

**To update:**

```bash
cd backend
make generate
```

## Generated Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `permissions.ts` | Permission codes, permission helpers |
| `entity-types.ts` | Entity names, table mappings, configurations |
| `entity-config.ts` | Menu configuration, labels, groups |
| `hooks.ts` | React hooks: `usePermissions()`, `useEntityCRUD()`, `useEntityAccess()` |
| `index.ts` | Re-exports all generated code |

## Usage Examples

### Check Permissions

```typescript
import { PERMISSIONS, usePermissions } from '@vira/core/generated';

function MyComponent() {
  const perms = usePermissions({
    permissions: user.permissions,
    companyId: user.companyId,
    locationId: user.locationId,
  });

  if (perms.can(PERMISSIONS.USERS_CREATE)) {
    return <CreateUserButton />;
  }

  return null;
}
```

### Entity CRUD Permissions

```typescript
import { ENTITY_NAMES, useEntityCRUD } from '@vira/core/generated';

function OrderActions() {
  const crud = useEntityCRUD(ENTITY_NAMES.ORDER, {
    permissions: user.permissions,
    companyId: user.companyId,
  });

  return (
    <>
      {crud.canCreate && <CreateButton />}
      {crud.canUpdate && <EditButton />}
      {crud.canDelete && <DeleteButton />}
    </>
  );
}
```

### Menu Filtering

```typescript
import { MENU_GROUPS, filterMenuByPermissions } from '@vira/core/generated';

function Sidebar() {
  const menuItems = filterMenuByPermissions(
    Object.values(MENU_GROUPS).flat(),
    user.permissions
  );

  return (
    <nav>
      {menuItems.map(item => (
        <MenuItem key={item.id} {...item} />
      ))}
    </nav>
  );
}
```

### Entity Configuration

```typescript
import { ENTITY_CONFIGS, getEntityConfig } from '@vira/core/generated';

function EntityInfo({ entity }: { entity: EntityName }) {
  const config = getEntityConfig(entity);

  return (
    <div>
      <p>Table: {config.table}</p>
      <p>Tenancy: {config.tenancy}</p>
      <p>Location Scoped: {config.locationScoped ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Regeneration

This code is automatically regenerated when you run:

```bash
make generate
```

in the backend directory.

The codegen tool reads `backend/entities.yaml` and generates:
- Backend Go code (CRUD handlers, tenancy rules, etc.)
- Frontend TypeScript code (this directory)

**Single source of truth:** `backend/entities.yaml`
